sentences.text: Thaumatosaurus is an extinct genus of plesiosaur whose name means 'wonder reptile'.
The genus Thaumatosaurus was described by paleontologist Christian Erich Hermann von Meyer in 1841.

Thaumatosaurus belongs to the family Plesiosauridae, but it is currently considered a nomen dubium because its holotype — the specimen the species is based on — can only be identified as an indeterminate plesiosaur.
Specimens once attributed to Thaumatosaurus are now recognized as the holotypes for the genera Eurycleidus, Meyerasaurus, and Rhomaleosaurus.
Thaumatosaurus lived during the Bathonian stage, between 168.2 and 165.3 million years ago.
